provenance.dataset: nuScenes v1.0-mini official mini_train camera key frames
limitations: The ONNX model still uses fixed synthetic all-visible projection and zero CAN-bus; real per-frame geometry is not supplied.
This calibrates real image inputs for that fixed cold graph; head activation statistics may differ from a real-geometry temporal deployment.
Calibration is not nuScenes mAP/NDS evaluation; mini_val is held out and must not be used to fit quantization ranges.
provenance.preprocessing: OpenCV unchanged BGR uint8 -> float32; subtract BGR [103.53,116.28,123.675], std=1; no RGB conversion, resize, flip or augmentation; then bottom zero-pad 900x1600 to 928x1600; N,V,C,H,W

sampling.method: balanced scene quotas; nearest frames to uniform time-bin centers

diagnosis: Constant Conv weights pass through Identity aliases; GPU reproduction fails with alias weights and succeeds with direct initializers. Target Conv activation ranges are valid.
